The problem: the Meeting Tax
Every company pays a Meeting Tax. Regulated companies pay it on every decision.
Judgment lives in senior people, so consequential decisions wait for a meeting. Regulated teams cannot paste that work into a public chatbot, so the meeting stays the bottleneck.

Mission
Expand human working memory from 7 items to 1 million, and make it available 24/7.
An executive's judgment is bottlenecked into a 40-hour week and about seven items of working memory. Pair each critical role with a Wisdom Twin holding a million-token context of that role's decisions, and the week changes shape.

How it works
Ingest, Twin, Operate™. Evidence becomes judgment, under human control.
Step 1
Ingest
Authorized evidence only: emails, meetings, docs, SOPs, filings. Immutable evidence objects with source-level permissions.
Step 2
Twin
Decision episodes rebuilt: why, not just what. The role is the unit. Nothing is authoritative until a named human signs off.
Step 3
Operate
One-press huddles and async reviews with cited answers, policy gates and safe decline. Every action audited.
Decision → Audit → Smarter Twin. Every governed decision compounds.
Deployable in private cloud, VPC, on-premises or air-gapped. Model-agnostic.
